newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Spectrum says fund invests US$20 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Spectrum says fund invests US$20 mln.

text.p: Telecommunications services reseller Spectrum Network Systems Ltd said on Wednesday that private equity fund The AIF Telecommunications Fund intended to invest US$20 million in the company.

Spectrum said AIF Telecommunications, an extension to the Asian Infrastructure Fund, would make the investment by way of about 50 million three year eight percent cumulative redeemable convertible preference shares to be issued at 50 cents each.
The fund would also be issued 14.1 million three year options to acquire ordinary shares at an exercise price of A$0.50 per share.

Spectrum said the Fund would be entitled to appoint two new members to the board of Spectrum once shareholders approval of the transaction hds been received at a proposed extraordinary meeting of shareholders, expected to be held later this month.
The transaction was subject to Foreign Investment Review Board approval and final documentation.

Spectrum said the fund is a US$156 million private equity fund and has been set up to invest in non-listed equity securities of entities engaged in the development, ownership or operation of telecoms facilities in the Asian region.
